name: Farm Fresh Berhad
summary: Farm Fresh Berhad, along with its associated entities, primarily engages in dairy farming, specifically the raising of dairy cows. The company also manufactures, promotes, and distributes a diverse array of dairy and plant-based products within Malaysia and Australia. Its extensive product line features fresh and flavored milks, plant-based milk alternatives, yogurt drinks, various yogurts, goat milk, and other related items. Beyond its core activities, the company manages property holdings, engages in goat husbandry, and maintains a genetic bank of Australian Fresian Sahiwal dairy cattle's semen and embryos. Additionally, it operates and licenses the Jomcha chain of beverage outlets, retails dairy goods, markets and sells jams and sauces, and provides butter, cream, and cheese. These offerings are marketed under various brand names, including Farm Fresh, Yarra Farm, Yarra by Farm Fresh, Master Barista, Henry Jones, Nubian Goat's Milk, and Jom Cha by Farm Fresh. The firm also exports its products throughout the Asia-Pacific region. Founded in 2010, Farm Fresh Berhad's headquarters are located in Johor Bahru, Malaysia.
